objective: Compare WSL Linux candidates with one fixed Toybox probe and retain only evidence-proven configuration requirements.

cmake_fetchcontent.source_evidence: CMakeLists.txt FetchContent declarations at pinned WSL commit

active_build.visual_studio_install_command: & 'C:\controlled-inputs\ultra-minimal-wsl\vs-community-layout\vs_setup.exe' --quiet --wait --norestart --noWeb --installPath 'C:\controlled-toolchain\VS2022' --in 'C:\controlled-inputs\ultra-minimal-wsl\vs-community-layout\Response.json'; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Visual Studio installation failed with exit $LASTEXITCODE." }
active_build.runtime_boundary: This approval packet ends after compilation, package hashing, output-manifest verification, evidence extraction, and fixture shutdown. Installation of the produced MSI and every candidate probe remain unauthorized until the produced hashes are recorded and separately plan-validated.
active_build.approval_boundary: Input placement, Visual Studio installation, elevation, fixture operation, compilation, and fixture shutdown require one fresh bundled approval.

clean_directories.rule: refuse reuse of any existing source, build, or output directory

visual_studio.identity_gate: ChannelManifest.json, Catalog.json, Response.json, product ID/version, x64 architecture, and all 15 requested IDs must match

nuget.network_policy: The overlay copies only verified nuget.exe, writes a config with one cleared local folder source, and fails if the executable is absent. No source URL, fallback source, user config, or package cache is accepted.

fetchcontent.network_policy: Both source directories must be extracted from the two hash-verified local archives; a missing or mismatched archive stops configure.

toolchain.signing_choice: Unsigned controlled MSI/MSIX artifacts; no ESRP or development certificate is accepted. Later trial installs only the MSI.

commands.preflight: Verify staged inputs against manifests, refuse existing directories, verify Community identity, and verify CMake, MSBuild, SDK 10.0.26100.0, and the Visual Studio 17 2022 generator.
commands.configure: cmake -S <candidate source> -B <candidate build> -G "Visual Studio 17 2022" -A x64 -DCMAKE_SYSTEM_VERSION=10.0.26100.0 -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DPACKAGE_VERSION=2.7.12.0 -DWSL_NUGET_PACKAGE_VERSION=2.7.12 -DWSL_BUILD_WSL_SETTINGS=FALSE -DOFFICIAL_BUILD=FALSE -DSKIP_PACKAGE_SIGNING=TRUE -DCONTROLLED_NUGET_CACHE=C:\controlled-inputs\ultra-minimal-wsl\controlled-inputs\nuget "-DCMAKE_MODULE_PATH=<procedure root>;<candidate source>\cmake" -DFETCHCONTENT_SOURCE_DIR_GSL=<GSL source> -DFETCHCONTENT_SOURCE_DIR_NLOHMANNJSON=<nlohmann/json source>
commands.restore: The configure command must select control-plane/controlled-package-offline/FindNUGET.cmake; its exact restore arguments are recorded under inputs.nuget.restore_arguments.
commands.verification: Generate controlled-output-SHA256SUMS with UTF-8 SHA-256 lines sorted by slash-separated path relative to the build root; include only the closed expected output set and verify no output is outside the build root.

stop_conditions: any input or output hash differs
CMake attempts HTTPS or NuGet reports a non-local source
the offline module is not selected
a package is missing or restored from a global cache
an output is missing, extra, outside the build root, or absent from the manifest
the operation would require elevation, installation, shutdown, custom boot, or runtime
controlled_package_build.execution_boundary: The minimal-v3-stock-ns build script and toolchain command are repository-validated but non-executable. Fresh approval may authorize only toolchain installation and compilation through output hashing; candidate package installation and runtime remain separately unauthorized.

commands: wsl.exe --distribution Toybox-Minimal --exec /bin/sh -c "test -r /proc/self/status && test -d /sys && test -c /dev/null && printf toybox-ok"
fixed_probe.instrumentation: same WSL WPR profile, System/Application event filter, new %TEMP%\wsl-crashes files, and evidence manifest; debug-console capture is disabled for all three candidates

stock_calibration_attempt_001.reason: The disposable fixture did not have WSL installed. The first fixed process reported 'The Windows Subsystem for Linux is not installed'; no Toybox command was attempted and the nominal recovery probe encountered the same prerequisite failure.
stock_calibration_attempt_001.next_action: Install the pinned stock MSI and import the pinned Toybox rootfs before using a new trial ID. Do not append inventory rows for this infrastructure attempt.

stock_calibration_attempt_002.reason: The pinned MSI installed and version verification passed, but Toybox import failed before either fixed probe because Microsoft-Windows-Subsystem-Linux and VirtualMachinePlatform were both Disabled.
stock_calibration_attempt_002.next_action: Enable both pinned Windows optional-feature prerequisites, reboot the fixture, import Toybox, and use a new trial ID. Do not append inventory rows for this infrastructure attempt.

fixture_baseline_preparation.enable_wsl_feature_command: $p = Start-Process -FilePath 'dism.exe' -ArgumentList @('/online','/enable-feature','/featurename:Microsoft-Windows-Subsystem-Linux','/all','/norestart') -Wait -PassThru; if ($p.ExitCode -notin @(0,3010)) { throw "WSL feature enable failed with exit $($p.ExitCode)." }
fixture_baseline_preparation.enable_vmp_feature_command: $p = Start-Process -FilePath 'dism.exe' -ArgumentList @('/online','/enable-feature','/featurename:VirtualMachinePlatform','/all','/norestart') -Wait -PassThru; if ($p.ExitCode -notin @(0,3010)) { throw "VMP feature enable failed with exit $($p.ExitCode)." }
fixture_baseline_preparation.reboot_requirement: Restart the disposable fixture, re-establish PowerShell Direct, and require both optional features Enabled before import.
fixture_baseline_preparation.toybox_import_command: if (Test-Path -LiteralPath 'C:\WSL\Toybox-Minimal') { throw 'Toybox import directory already exists.' }; & wsl.exe --import Toybox-Minimal 'C:\WSL\Toybox-Minimal' 'C:\controlled-inputs\ultra-minimal-wsl\toybox-minimal-wsl-rootfs.tar.gz' --version 2; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Toybox import failed with exit $LASTEXITCODE." }
postconditions: both Windows optional features are Enabled after the controlled reboot
the installed WSL version remains exactly 2.7.12.0
Toybox-Minimal is the only newly imported distribution and uses the pinned rootfs
the package, rootfs, probe, manifest, and WPR profile retain their recorded hashes
WSL is shut down before calibration
fixture_baseline_preparation.approval_boundary: The consumed attempt-003 approval does not carry forward to custom-package compilation, installation, or probing.
fixture_baseline_preparation.completion: Both optional features are Enabled, the controlled reboot completed, Toybox-Minimal imported from the pinned rootfs, and pre-calibration shutdown passed.

stock_calibration.approval_boundary: Attempt-003 approval was consumed. No approval carries forward to minimal-v3-stock-ns compilation, installation, fixture operation, or probing.

missing_before_runtime_plan_validation: exact installation and stock restoration commands bound to the produced package
minimal_v3_stock_ns.runtime_boundary: Compilation approval does not authorize package installation or this reserved trial. After a successful build, record all produced hashes, generate the candidate manifest, plan-validate installation and restoration against the accepted stock baseline, and stop for fresh approval.

invariant_inputs: same WSL 2.7.12 source/package baseline and per-candidate hash-verified package manifest
same 45-second process timeout, 30-second shutdown timeout, and exact command arguments
same WPR profile SHA-256 3f829a9af733d6dce9454a1df2e2aa07096acaaed5b6865ffb5c202d089479f2, event filter, crash capture, and disabled debug console
same second fixed-probe stock recovery proof
evidence: exact package, candidate manifest, rootfs, WPR profile, and probe hashes
separate stdout, stderr, exit code, timeout, arguments, and timestamps for every wsl.exe process
WSL WPR/ETW trace and relevant Windows event delta
new WSL crash artifacts; debug-console evidence is uniformly not enabled in this comparison
independent stock-baseline recovery proof using the same probe identities, commands, timeouts, instrumentation, and rules

ledger.finalization: After both staging manifests verify and stock recovery passes, copy the first staging tree to recovery-harness/trials/<TRIAL_ID>/candidate and the recovery tree to recovery-harness/trials/<TRIAL_ID>/recovery, write analysis.json plus one sorted final SHA-256 manifest covering both trees, rerun inventory_records.py with integrity ok, then append exactly one terminal trials.csv row and its matching trial-metadata.csv row. If extraction, verification, recovery, or inventory synchronization fails, append nothing.

candidate_trial_contract.infrastructure_boundary: Fixture start, transport, input placement, installation, extraction, and rollback are prerequisites only. Failure before the first candidate probe wsl.exe process, an absent Toybox-Minimal registration, or failure to recover/extract creates no candidate result and must not cause probe variation or infrastructure-tool development inside the minimisation loop.
candidate_trial_contract.classification: The probe may report B6-T only when the exact smoke succeeds and required management, trace, event, shutdown, hash, and interval evidence is complete. Other candidate intervals remain UNRESOLVED-TRACE-REQUIRED or INCOMPLETE-EVIDENCE until analysis identifies the highest directly supported B0-B5 gate. Infrastructure disposition is NOT-A-CANDIDATE-RESULT. Missing recovery prohibits ledger finalization and every positive classification.

preconditions: all inputs and produced candidates match recorded hashes
fresh explicit approval is present for every shutdown, installation, fixture operation, and boot
a known-good stock recovery path is independently available
acceptance: stock calibration reaches B6-T with the fixed Toybox probe
both namespace siblings are tested from the same baseline
runtime evidence selects the namespace bundle or records an unresolved result
every retained non-mkroot facility is later proved by removal failure and restoration success
stock recovery succeeds after every trial
stop_conditions: any required hash differs or an input is missing
the operation would modify the physical host package or directly write beneath C:\Program Files\WSL outside the approved MSI transaction inside the disposable fixture
the fixture or trigger fails before the candidate interval
evidence interval, process results, trace, manifest, or recovery proof is incomplete
a timeout occurs without independent proof that launched processes stopped
the proposed response is new generalized VM-control or remoting infrastructure rather than a candidate change
